mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport or national identity document of each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police or civil registry authority of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / excerpt from commercial registry for corporate shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official commercial registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization if not a Hague Convention signatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney granted to the Spanish notary or incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or public authority of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or proof of source of funds for subscription of capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualified financial institution in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization if required by Spanish notarial practice

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Under Ley 10/2010 and EU AML Directives, all UBOs and directors are subject to mandatory screening against Spanish Official State Gazette (BOE) published sanctions lists, European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list, and United Nations Security Council consolidated list. Enhanced due diligence applies to any politically exposed person (PEP) as defined in Article 14 of Ley 10/2010. Screening results must be documented and retained for at least ten years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central – Online Denominación Social Certificate service (https://www.rmc.es)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: SL corporate names must be written in Spanish or any co-official language (Catalan, Basque, Galician, Valencian) using Latin alphabet characters. Spanish naming law prohibits misleading, offensive, or confusingly similar names; acronyms and abbreviations are generally not permitted unless they are demonstrated to be part of the natural name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Cualquier término que requiera autorización administrativa previa, incluidas referencias a la Corona, al Estado, a Comunidades Autónomas, a organismos oficiales, o a símbolos nacionales
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The negative name certificate issued by Registro Mercantil Central is valid for 90 calendar days. An extension can be applied for before expiry by submitting a new request for the same name, which shall be considered as a first reservation for an additional period of 90 days. If the name is rejected, the applicant may file a jurisdictional appeal before the Directorate General of Legal Security and Public Trust (Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública) within one calendar month from notification, and thereafter an enforceable administrative claim before the Spanish National Court (Juzgado Central de lo Contencioso-Administrativo).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissive for administrative and correspondence purposes, but for a contract manufacturing entity under ISIC 2610 (PCBA assembly), the tax authorities and registry require actual operational premises, local staff, and equipment to demonstrate commercial substance. A pure virtual mailbox without physical production capacity is inadmissible for Spanish corporate registration and will be challenged under transfer pricing and general anti-abuse rules.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 35% risk of unannounced physical inspection within the first 24 months, due to the manufacturing nature of the activity and the Spanish taxation authority's obligation to verify effective establishment under the OECD and EU anti-abuse framework.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for virtual office and legal mail support in Madrid or Barcelona

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC), Articles 19-22, 34, 58, 62, 65, 133 and 210; Real Decreto 1784/1996 (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil); Ley 14/2013, de 27 de septiembre, de apoyo a los emprendedores.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central for name reservation and Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office for enrolment of the deed; Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria for the tax identification number.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public incorporation deed (escritura pública de constitución), followed by inscription in the Mercantile Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Standard S.L. share capital must be at least EUR 3,000 fully subscribed and fully paid-in before recording. Cash contributions must be evidenced by a bank deposit certificate; no statutory escrow account is required for monetary contributions. A company may alternatively be formed under the 'formación sucesiva' regime with lower capital, subject to specific profit-distribution restrictions, until the EUR 3,000 threshold is reached.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: The incorporators approve the public deed of incorporation and the articles of association. The share capital is fully subscribed and paid-in in cash by the founding members. The registered office is fixed at Calle Ejemplo 10, 28013 Madrid, Spain. The following officers are appointed: [Full Name], sole administrator (Administrador Único); [Full Name], alternate administrator; and [Full Name], secretary. All appointees accept. The sole administrator is authorized to file the provisional CIF application, execute the mercantile registration, open bank accounts, hire staff, engage external advisors, obtain industrial and environmental permits, and take any ancillary action required to commence the PCBA contract manufacturing activity. This resolution is effective immediately and may be implemented by the administrator without further shareholder consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain negative name certification from the Central Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid, via the electronic portal of the Registradores de España
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application with at least two proposed Spanish company names. The Central Registry issues a certification negativa de denominación social confirming that no identical or confusingly similar name is already registered. The certificate is valid for three months and must be presented to the notary when executing the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Copy of promoter's passport, NIE or tax ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first proposed name is refused, the second or third name is automatically considered; otherwise re-file with fresh name proposals. If the certificate expires before notarial execution, apply for renewal or obtain a new certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open preliminary corporate bank account and deposit share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution; notary validating the capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a bank account in the name of the projected S.L. using the provisional name and obtain a certificado bancario de depósito showing deposit of at least EUR 3,000 as fully paid-up capital. Present the bank certificate to the notary to be attached to the deed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is deficient, require the bank to issue a corrected certificate; funds remain blocked until the company is registered and identified with a definitive NIF.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public incorporation deed before a Spanish notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (Notaría) of the city where the registered office is established
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the valid name certificate, bank deposit certificate, draft bylaws, and identification documents. The notary verifies identity, legal capacity, the legality of the bylaws, and the sufficiency of formalities, then formally executes the escritura pública de constitución. The notary will also request the provisional tax identification number (CIF) as part of the protocol.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of association / estatutos sociales
Passports, NIE and INLE or residence permits of founding members
Formal reservation of the CIF processing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects defective clauses, the draft is revised and the deed is re-executed. Post-execution errors are corrected by an amending notarial deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the provisional CIF from the State Tax Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Central or local office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Model 036/036 with the newly formed company data and the appointed legal representatives. The provisional CIF enables the company to pay taxes, sign contracts, and complete the Mercantile Registry inscription; it is later converted into a definitive CIF after registration.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEAT file is queried, resubmit with the deed copy and 036 rectification; the assigned CIF is preserved pending such procedural cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the S.L. in the provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notary's authorized first copy (primera copia autorizada) together with the provisional CIF and payment of registry arancel. The Registrar reviews substantive and formal compliance and makes the entry of incorporation. This inscription grants the company full legal personality and triggers publication in the BORME.
required_dossiers: Authorized first copy of the incorporation deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar suspends entry for defects, the administrator must cure the defects by a supplementary deed or clarifications and resubmit. Appeals lie to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convert provisional CIF to final tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), local taxation office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration in the Mercantile Registry, submit Model 036/036 to the AEAT indicating the definitive CIF, the legal address, the administrator data, and the planned economic activity under CNAE 2610.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration entry in the Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT rejects the update, correct the form and provide the Mercantile Registry certificate; the provisional CIF remains enforceable until final completion.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register as employer with the Social Security Treasury and log the workplace
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS), territorial direction of the workplace
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form TA.6 to obtain the employer contribution code (código de cuenta de cotización) and Form RTL to report the workplace. Register the company before personnel are engaged, normally within the ten days preceding the first employment start. Attach the definitive NIF and deed certificate.
required_dossiers: Copy of the registered incorporation deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If TGSS reports discrepancies, submit a formal written correction; retroactive recognition can be requested in justified cases.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Verify BORME publication and obtain certified registry certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial / BORME (Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Mercantile Registry publishes the incorporation statement in the BORME as notice to third parties. At the same time, request a certified registration certificate summarizing the incorporation, registered office, corporate purpose, and appointments; this certificate is used for banking counterparty onboarding and later license applications.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BORME publication is delayed, the applicant may request a direct certificate of non-publication or have the notary request an expedited certified copy.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección General de Industria of the relevant Comunidad Autónoma and the municipal licensing department; central policy coordination by the Ministerio de Industria, Comercio y Turismo.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Ambiental Integral y Licencia de Apertura o Comunicación Previa de Actividad Industrial for the assembly of printed circuit boards (PCBA contract manufacturing).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente, Vivienda y Ordenación del Territorio of the relevant Comunidad Autónoma, with coordination by the Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico for cross-regional matters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: The activity falls under the régimen de evaluación de impacto ambiental simplificada / comunicación ambiental when the installed capacity and chemical usage remain below the Annex thresholds; a full EIA report (evaluación de impacto ambiental ordinaria) is required only if the project meets substantive Annex I criteria under applicable state and regional legislation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must meet the limit values of Real Decreto 817/2015 and any municipal sewer by-law; volatile organic compounds (VOCs) from soldering and flux operations must comply with Directive 2010/75/EU; hazardous waste from chemicals, spent solder and cleaning solvents must be managed under Ley 7/2022 and Real Decreto 110/2015 (WEEE) / Real Decreto 219/2013; airborne particulate and noise limits must comply with local ordinances and occupational exposure limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certificate issued by a competent technician and accepted by the municipal fire inspection; structural load inspection certificate prepared by an architect or engineer; electrical installation compliance declaration under the Reglamento Electrotécnico de Baja Tensión; workplace risk-prevention audit under Ley 31/1995; and a municipal compatibility certificate confirming the industrial use is lawful at the chosen address.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) - Official portal: https://www.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign or non-resident entities obtain NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) by registering with AEAT using Form 036/037. Submission requires passport/ID, proof of address, and economic activity justification. Spanish tax representative (gestor) mandatory for non-residents; process completes in 30-60 days with digital certificate issuance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD Directive apply. Tax group (Grupos de Sociedades) election permits consolidated taxation for qualifying subsidiaries.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturae electronic invoicing for B2B transactions. Real-time digital stamping (sello electrónico) via AEAT platform with API integration for instant clearance, validation, and reporting obligations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods exported outside EU or services provided to non-EU residents under strict proof of export/non-residency. Requires valid customs export proof and non-resident recipient documentation.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fines up to 100% of evaded VAT plus interest and surcharges. Retrospective zero-rating clawback with full tax reassessment and potential criminal liability for fraudulent claims.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), acting under the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Spain Law 13/1994, together with the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Business (Ministerio de Economía, Comercio y Empresa) for foreign investment and exchange-related statistical filings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain operates under full capital and current account convertibility as a member of the EU and the euro area. No exchange control permits are required for ordinary trade settlement, profit repatriation, or capital transactions. Profit remittance is unrestricted for an SL once statutory annual accounts are approved, the legal reserve requirement is met, and any applicable Spanish withholding tax on dividends is satisfied; treaty relief may reduce the rate for non-resident shareholders. Settlement in EUR of cross-border flows is entirely free of exchange controls, subject only to statistical declarations and AML/KYC information obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory surrender requirements, mandatory conversion ratios, or time limits for export proceeds in Spain under the euro-area framework. A resident exporter may retain receipts in EUR or foreign currency and convert them at freely negotiated market rates. Exports and collections above the statistical threshold must be reported to Banco de España for balance-of-payments statistical purposes, typically through the entity's bank using the applicable declaration form.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Trade Finance Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium viability. EU-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) holding a passport under the EEA framework can open euro accounts for a Spanish SL without a branch. These entities are well-suited for collections, supplier payouts, and multi-currency settlement. However, they are not credit institutions and cannot provide trade finance, LC confirmations, or committed FX hedging. Some EMIs impose heightened scrutiny on non-EEA beneficial owners and may restrict wires to Latin American, East Asian, or offshore jurisdictions; a banking-grade correspondent arrangement is advisable for large trade flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance is commonly required at the initial corporate onboarding for the managing director or a duly authorized signatory to sign the mandate and maintain proof of identity. Most tier-1 Spanish banks do accept remote/video KYC for individuals with a recognised European ID or NIE card, but for non-resident corporate directors and beneficial owners, a physical branch visit or a Spanish notary-hosted identity verification is frequently mandated. Some banks permit a representative to handle the interview via power of attorney for the signing team, but the beneficial owner and statutory directors must provide original notarised documents, apostilled where necessary, and current passport/NIE copies.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value electronics procurement to China/Hong Kong linked to PCBA component sourcing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed procurement contracts, supplier certificates of origin, detailed commercial invoices with kilowatt-characterised goods descriptions, HS codes matching the PCB/PCBA scope (8517, 8536, 8542, 9030), packing lists, CMR/airway bills or bills of lading, and downloaded ERP transactions showing physical goods movement from supplier to bonded warehouse or final delivery.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusually rapid build-up of account turnover relative to stated equity and bank reference size
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited annual financial statements of the Spanish SL, shareholder structure memorandum with CV and passport details, board-approved business plan and cash-flow forecast for the PCBA contract manufacturing pipeline, existing purchase orders and master supply agreements, and tax/IVA returns evidence consistent with the turnover.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border dividend or intra-group loan repayment to a non-resident shareholder in a preferential tax treaty jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Clear ownership chain with notarised articles of incorporation and tax residence certificates, group transfer pricing documentation aligning with OECD guidelines, signed shareholder loan agreements with arm's-length interest rates, proof of Spanish corporate tax payment and reduced withholding tax treaty application (Form 210 or per treaty), and financial statements showing distributable reserves and legal reserve balance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transactions with politically exposed persons (PEPs) or entities incorporated in high-risk third countries (e.g., certain Latin American, Asian, or offshore zones)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full beneficial ownership register disclosure under Royal Decree 571/2023, independent sanction screening results, certified copies of corporate incorporation documents with apostille, public transparency screening evidence, and a legally binding customer attestation of commercial purpose and non-sanction-linked activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For non-resident shareholder equity or shareholder loan contributions, the compliant route is a SWIFT MT103 wire to the SL's euro account in Spain using the beneficiary IBAN and BIC codes. The sender's bank must provide the exact purpose code, usually a capital transaction / direct investment code such as 'GD' or the OECD/EU standard Balance of Payments purpose code for equity acquisitions, accompanied by a clear payment narrative referencing the company's CIF and the investment intent. Within one month of capital injection, the SL must file a foreign investment declaration with the Trade Registry (Registro Mercantil) and the Ministry of Economy under Spanish foreign investment regulations; when the investment exceeds the statutory threshold, a prior screen may be required. For any loan disbursement, execute and keep the signed financing agreement, identify the ECB/EURIBOR benchmark or fixed rate, and report the loan in the Bank of Spain's balance-of-payments statistics through the banking platform.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for the PCBA contract manufacturing activity uses the standard Euro and international corridors. For direct payments to suppliers or subcontractors, SWIFT MT103 messages carry the payment, with beneficiary bank's BIC and IBAN; for correspondent-bank-cleared currencies, MT202 is appended as the cover payment. For supply-chain purchases from non-EU parties, irrevocable documentary letters of credit are issued subject to ICC UCP600, typically payable at sight via an advising bank; for Eurozone suppliers, SEPA Credit Transfers or SEPA Instant are used for smaller operational disbursements, while SWIFT remains the rail for non-EEA and exotic currency payments. Every disbursement must be matched with the underlying order, invoice, and customs/border documentation for AML and tax compliance. Trade finance products such as open-account with buyer credit, back-to-back LCs, and invoice financing can be layered for the contract manufacturing cycle.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot EUR/USD, EUR/CNH, EUR/LatAm currency outrights for immediate settlement
Outright FX forwards (FXA) with tenors matched to known trade settlement dates

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted currencies, primarily when the counterparty rupee, Argentine peso, or certain Latin American currencies may be required and the counterparty bank supports NDF as a hedge
Cross-currency swaps for long-term financing of the Spanish SL's euro-denominated working capital or for swapping shareholder loan currency exposure
FX options (European-style) for protecting margins on large PCBA tender bids
Currency swaps structured under master agreement terms and subject to MiFID/ESMA derivatives regulations for non-ultimate-consumers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts and General Meeting approvals (Cuentas Anuales, Junta General, Deposito de Cuentas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial / Registro Mercantil Central
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Approval by shareholders' meeting within first 6 months after fiscal year-end; deposit with the Commercial Registry within 1 month after approval; for 31 December year-end, latest deposit is approximately 30 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit triggers 'cierre registral' (registry closure), preventing registration of any subsequent corporate or share transfers; administrative fines up to EUR 300 and possible loss of good standing; persistent non-compliance may lead to judicial dissolution and final deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between the 1st and 25th day of the month following the 6-month period after the fiscal year-end; for 31 December year-end, filing window is 1-25 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge plus late-payment interest; penalty of 50% of the tax amount for untimely submission; criminal audit exposure for persistently non-compliant entities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner Declaration (Declaración de Titularidad Real - DTR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial / Registro de Titularidad Real
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after the approval of the annual accounts; for 31 December year-end, expected by 30 July; any changes in beneficial ownership or shareholding percentages must be declared within 10 days of the relevant corporate registry event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or inaccuracies subject to administrative penalties up to EUR 3,000; registry closure until declaration is corrected; non-compliance can restrict public subsidies and public procurement access.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For all VAT-registered Spanish SLs, due between 1 and 30 January following the close of the calendar year; zero-reporting and extensive transaction data must be included.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties of 50% of amounts due plus late-payment interest; loss of VAT operating regime for habitual late filing; the entity may be excluded from Censos de Empresarios, impairing invoice issuance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Applicable when, in aggregate, related-party transactions exceed EUR 250,000 or when qualifying transfer pricing documentation is required; filing window is the same as the Modelo 200 — 1-25 July for 31 December year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 1,000 EUR per data item or group of omitted data (minimum 5,000 EUR); assessment against undervalued or overvalued controlled transactions and adjustment of the corporate tax base.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory independent audit for an SL when, at the close of two consecutive fiscal years, at least two of the following thresholds are exceeded: balance sheet total greater than EUR 2,850,000; net annual turnover greater than EUR 5,700,000; average number of employees greater than 50. Audit is also compulsory for entities forming a consolidated group and for public-interest or financing-regulated entities, regardless of these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts must be prepared under Spanish GAAP (Plan General de Contabilidad, Real Decreto 1514/2007, as updated by Real Decreto 1/2021). Consolidated groups may adopt EU-endorsed International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the European Union.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: In Spain, an SL must file an annual UBO declaration (DTR) with the Commercial Registry within one month after the approval of the annual accounts. The declaration must identify all natural persons who directly or indirectly own or control more than 25% of the share capital or voting rights. Any change in ownership or control must be declared within 10 days after the relevant transaction or registration event. This serves both as the annual confirmation of shareholder continuity and as the mandatory disclosure of beneficial ownership.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 500 – 1,500 USD per annum for a standard Spanish SL registered office and corporate secretarial agent package, depending on province and agent service level.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 3,500 – 12,000 USD per annum for a mandatory independent audit of a small to mid-cap Spanish SL, depending on asset size, turnover, transaction volume, and audited group structure.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% CIT rate for newly-created eligible entities during the first two tax periods with a positive tax base; 95% participation exemption for qualifying dividends and capital gains from non-resident subsidiaries; R&D and technological innovation tax credit of 25% (with a cap of 50% of the net tax quota); patent box partial exemption; 20% rate for cooperative societies but not applicable to SLs.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Indefinite - no statutory expiry (post-2015 tax losses) with annual offset cap of 70% for taxpayers with net turnover ≥ EUR 20 million and 50% for net turnover ≥ EUR 60 million

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Modelo 200), Impuesto sobre Sociedades annual CIT return; filed electronically via AEAT Sede Electrónica (https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 calendar days after the end of the six-month anniversary of the fiscal year-end. Example: calendar-year entity must file by 25 July.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer legal identification (NIF, corporate name, address).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholder does not enter Form 200; the Spanish SL files using its own Spanish NIF.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax period start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the SL's registered fiscal year. Non-calendar-year is accepted if registered with AEAT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent and temporary differences reconciling accounting result to taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For PCBA contract manufacturing, include inventory transfer pricing adjustments and intercompany expense add-backs. Non-resident parent does not file this section.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Assessable taxable base after statutory loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure loss-offset caps are respected; non-resident parent controls the tax group through accounting consolidation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full tax quota applying the applicable rate (25% or 15%).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the SL qualifies as a new company, 15% applies; non-resident ownership does not affect the rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Result of return: amount to pay or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any payment due must be settled by the statutory deadline; refund is credited to the SL's Spanish bank account.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without a prior AEAT requirement triggers surcharges: 5% (delay up to 3 months), 10% (3–6 months), 15% (6–12 months), 20% (over 12 months) plus late interest (Art. 27 LGT). If no tax is due, a €200 fixed fine applies. Filing after an AEAT request entails penalties between 50% and 100% of the amount not paid.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 202 (Modelo 202), advance instalment payment of Spanish CIT; filed electronically via AEAT.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (three advance payments per year for a calendar-year taxpayer)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: First instalment due 20 April; second instalment due 20 October; third instalment due 20 December. Non-calendar tax periods shift the deadlines by the same 25-day/6-month rule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax base to be used for the instalment calculation, based on the latest agreed tax assessment or accounting result.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the SL's own pre-offset tax base as per Spanish rules; the foreign parent's facts do not alter the instalment base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Instalment calculation method (official percentage method or 60% profit-based method).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For PCBA contract manufacturers, consistency with TP margins is essential. Both methods must respect arm's-length evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount payable; bank direct debit reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Instalments are not final returns but are creditable against the annual Form 200 liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file an instalment or filing late incurs a late-filing surcharge and late interest. An inspector can assess 50%–100% penalty on the omitted instalment if there is no reasonable cause.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced DTA rate or EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive exemption, the non-resident beneficial owner must supply a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) before the distribution. The Spanish SL applies the reduced rate at the time of payment if the TRC is in hand; if the full 19% was withheld, the non-resident must file a refund claim via AEAT Form 210 (or 211) within the four-year statute of limitations. For EU corporate shareholders holding at least 5% of the Spanish SL capital for an uninterrupted 12-month period, a 100% exemption may apply, subject to the anti-abuse / substance test.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax rates: interest 19%; royalties 24%. Treaty-protected rates commonly reduce interest to 10% or 0% (EU Interest & Royalties Directive with minimum 25% shareholding) and royalties to 5%–10%. The reduced treaty rate must be supported by a TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 250,000 aggregate annual related-party transactions (if total controlled transactions do not exceed this amount, no TP documentation obligation); Country-by-Country Report required for groups with consolidated revenue ≥ EUR 750 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain has no standalone Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to offshore financial centres, but general anti-abuse rules, CFC rules and the OECD Principal Purpose Test impose substance requirements. A PCBA contract manufacturer must have operating premises, manufacturing equipment, qualified employees, strategic risk management, and commercial decision-taking in Spain. Absent economic substance, treaty benefits may be denied, profits re-attributed to the parent, and the corporate veil may be pierced.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful concealment of taxable income through falsified supplier invoices for PCBA components, inflated intercompany service fees, or undisclosed shipments to non-resident distributors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty from 50% to 100% of the evaded amount plus late interest (Art. 191 LGT). Criminal prosecution under Art. 305 Penal Code imposes imprisonment of 1–6 years and a fine of 2–6 times the defrauded amount where the tax loss exceeds EUR 120,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false returns are criminally liable; courts may impose travel bans, attachment of personal assets, and disqualification from managing companies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Spanish SL as a pure postal box with no genuine production, no local personnel, no board meetings, and no customer-facing business; profits accumulated but no economic activity actually performed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AEAT may apply anti-abuse rules (Art. 15 LGT) to recharacterise the structure; treaty benefits denied under OECD MLI Principal Purpose Test; CFC rules can attribute undistributed profits to resident shareholders; fictitious invoice penalties can reach 50% of the amount of the transactions involved.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced, leaving directors jointly and severally liable for unpaid corporate tax; complicity in sham arrangements can support criminal charges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing PCBA sale goods below cost or above arm's length; charging excessive management fees or royalties to the foreign parent; failing to prepare or maintain the required Local File / Master File.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AEAT adjusts taxable income to the arm's-length result, adds late interest, and imposes documentation penalties: EUR 1,500 per inaccurate or incomplete data item (max EUR 15,000); complete failure to provide documentation can attract penalties up to EUR 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and tax advisors who knowingly certify mispriced documentation are jointly liable for the adjusted tax and interest; fraudulent TP documentation may trigger criminal liability for tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Systematic use of cash-intensive treasury flows, unexplained payments from third-party conduit accounts in tax havens, or omission of beneficial ownership identification in the PCBA supply chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Ley 10/2010, serious AML infractions are fined EUR 150,000–EUR 1,500,000; very serious cases can reach EUR 15,000,000. Criminal money-laundering under the Penal Code carries imprisonment from 1 to 10 years plus fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors as obliged-entities face personal fines, suspension from commercial activity, travel restrictions, and criminal imprisonment if they knowingly facilitate laundering.
